search_files(query, path) where path names a DIRECTORY is unchanged — same hits, same ordering, same caps (regression pin)
search_files(query, path) where path does not exist returns an explicit Error: ..., never "(no matches)"

the repo-root confinement and deny-list of _safe_path still apply to a file path — a file outside the root or on the deny-list is refused exactly as a directory is
search_files's docstring states that path may name a file (scanned as one file) or a directory (walked), and that an unsearchable path returns Error: ...
